<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_snc_campus360_mock_interview</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Campus360 - Generate Interview QR URL</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    var baseUrl = gs.getProperty('glide.servlet.uri');

    var qrUrl =
        baseUrl +
        'sp?id=qr_attendance&interview_id=' +
        current.getUniqueValue();

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_snc_campus360_mock_interview');

    if (gr.get(current.getUniqueValue())) {

        gr.setValue('qr_code', qrUrl);
        gr.setValue('qr_status', 'Generated');

        gr.update();
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-20 07:19:17</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>8a737ebf9d5b03107f4456802862a759</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Campus360 - Generate Interview QR URL</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Campus360" source="x_snc_campus360">7cd68adee41703107f44d305db800ec3</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Campus360">7cd68adee41703107f44d305db800ec3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_8a737ebf9d5b03107f4456802862a759</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-20 07:50:51</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=8a737ebf9d5b03107f4456802862a759"/></record_update>
